description: This file defines the ConfigDao class, responsible for data access operations related to configuration settings within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to set, get, and retrieve all configuration key-value pairs, interacting with the Config entity and repository.
external_files: some base class file for BaseDao (not explicitly named in the snippet but assumed)

classes.name: ConfigDao
classes.description: A data access object class for managing configuration entities within the OrangeHRM system. Provides methods to create, retrieve, and list configuration values.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value for a given configuration key, creating a new config if it does not exist, and persists the change.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given configuration key, returning null if the key does not exist.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Returns all configuration key-value pairs as an associative array.
